description: Defines the LoanTermVariations entity class for representing variations in loan terms within the Fineract loan portfolio module.

classes.name: LoanTermVariations
classes.description: Entity class representing variations in loan terms, including applicable date, type, value, and status.

methods.name: getTermType
methods.description: Returns the type of the loan term variation as a LoanTermVariationType enum.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the entity to a data transfer object (LoanTermVariationsData).

methods.name: getTermApplicableFrom
methods.description: Returns the date from which the variation is applicable.

methods.name: fetchTermApplicaDate
methods.description: Fetches the applicable date for the variation.

methods.name: getTermValue
methods.description: Returns the decimal value of the variation.

methods.name: getDateValue
methods.description: Returns the date value of the variation.

methods.name: fetchDateValue
methods.description: Fetches the date value of the variation.

methods.name: setDateValue
methods.description: Sets the date value of the variation.

methods.name: setTermApplicableFrom
methods.description: Sets the applicable date for the variation.

methods.name: setDecimalValue
methods.description: Sets the decimal value of the variation.

methods.name: getOnLoanStatus
methods.description: Returns the current loan status associated with the variation.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the variation is active.

methods.name: parent
methods.description: Returns the parent variation if any.

methods.name: updateIsActive
methods.description: Updates the active status of the variation.
